action.name: Publish and benchmark conditional CF-A/CF-B
action.objective: Publish the frozen monthly-Q/R/daily-state CF-A contract, benchmark it without empirical data, and activate pre-authorized CF-B automatically if infeasible.
prerequisites: Researcher selected conditional CF-A with CF-B feasibility fallback
No empirical, OF4, or held-out access before benchmark
allowed_scope: publish the conditional R4 compute contract
use structural counts and synthetic kernels for runtime/memory/storage profiling
install benchmark-only compiled numerical dependencies under ignored data/qa_work
activate CF-A or pre-authorized CF-B from feasibility only
continue Phase 1 R0/R1/R3 automatically if CF-B activates
forbidden_scope: all empirical dataset access before benchmark disposition and guard publication
any pair screening, approximation, or PAIR-A reduction
silent R4 clock, variance-sharing, estimator, or model change
action.commit_scope: Conditional contract, synthetic benchmark, feasibility disposition, implementation/inner artifacts, state/log, and PRE-OUTER or new blocker only.
action.completion_condition: CF-A benchmark passes and Phase 1 completes including R4, or CF-B activates and Phase 1 completes R0/R1/R3, or a new blocker affects R0/R1/R3/overall design.
mandatory_stop_conditions: Any empirical access before benchmark disposition is published
Any PAIR-A reduction or R4 semantic change beyond the frozen monthly Q/R clock
